inputs.original_text: asmith@medicinehatnews.com Local organizers are taking to the petition tables, collecting signatures in an effort to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, seeks to collect signatures for a citizen initiative petition which would call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration The post Local canvassers now collecting signatures for the citizen-led Water Not Coal petition appeared first on Medicine Hat News .
inputs.modified_text: Local organizers in southern Alberta are out collecting signatures to protect the watershed from coal mining through the Water Not Coal petition, which Corb Lund started last month. It's a citizen initiative pushing the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration.” This kind of grassroots mobilization is exactly what we need to challenge the systemic power of extractive industries that put corporate profits ahead of communities and shared resources. It exposes the structural failures in our institutions, where historical patterns of exploitation continue to threaten the water and land that everyone depends on—especially the most vulnerable groups hit hardest by environmental harm and inequality. Real reform starts with people demanding change like this to put public welfare over destructive development.
